```{r all-data-reports}
#| results: 'asis'
#| echo: false

# Stick entirely to RefManageR for reading and printing
library("RefManageR")

# Read the file text to parse out your sections manually
bibfiletext0 <- readLines(con = here::here("content/references.bib"))

# Read the actual bibliography objects using RefManageR
bib <- RefManageR::ReadBib(here::here("content/references.bib"))

# 1. Parse out the specific section of the .bib file
sect_start <- grep(pattern = "%  * Survey Data Reports", x = bibfiletext0, fixed = TRUE)
sect_end <- grep(pattern = "% * Code books *****************************************************************", x = bibfiletext0, fixed = TRUE)
bibfiletext0 <- bibfiletext0[sect_start:sect_end]

# 2. Extract the citation keys (@...)
cite_start <- grep(pattern = "@", x = bibfiletext0, fixed = TRUE)

bibfiletext0 <- unlist(lapply(X = strsplit(split = "{", x = bibfiletext0[cite_start], fixed = TRUE), "[[", 2))
bibfiletext0 <- gsub(pattern = ",", replacement = "", x = bibfiletext0, fixed = TRUE)
bibfiletext0 <- trimws(bibfiletext0)

names0 <- c("AI" = "Aleutian Islands", 
            "GOA" = "Gulf of Alaska", 
            "EBS" = "Eastern and Northern Bering Sea", 
            "BSS" = "Bering Sea Slope", 
            "SAPcrab" = "Bering Sea Crab")

# 3. Loop through regions and print sequentially
for (i in seq_along(names0)) {
  
  # Find the keys that match the region code (e.g., "AI", "GOA")
  # Fixed names(names0[i]) to names(names0)[i]
  cite_idx <- grep(pattern = names(names0)[i], x = bibfiletext0, fixed = TRUE)
  
  # Skip if no citations are found for this region to avoid errors
  if(length(cite_idx) == 0) next
  
  # Subset the RefManageR object using the found keys
  region_keys <- bibfiletext0[cite_idx]
  cite0 <- bib[region_keys]

  # Print headers
  cat(paste0('\n### ', unlist(names0[i]), '\n\n'))
  
  # Print cleanly formatted markdown citations directly
  print(cite0, .opts = list(style = "markdown"))
  
  # Print the markdown separator to close the section (Removed the :::)
  cat('\n\n---\n\n')
}
```
